description: This file defines an MCPHandler struct with methods for handling MCP-related HTTP API endpoints, including health checks, server restart, tools retrieval, status aggregation, event streaming, and metrics collection within a web server context using Gin framework.

classes.name: MCPHandler
classes.description: Handler for MCP-related HTTP API endpoints, managing MCP health, server control, tools, status, events, and metrics.

methods.name: NewMCPHandler
methods.description: Constructor for MCPHandler, initializes with UIService and AgentClient dependencies.

methods.name: GetMCPHealthHandler
methods.description: Handles requests for detailed MCP health information, returning summary or full details based on mode.

methods.name: RestartMCPServerHandler
methods.description: Handles requests to restart a specific MCP server, only in developer mode.

methods.name: GetMCPToolsHandler
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve tools from a specific MCP server, only in developer mode.

methods.name: GetMCPStatusHandler
methods.description: Provides overall MCP status across all nodes, with detailed info in developer mode.

methods.name: GetMCPEventsHandler
methods.description: Streams MCP events via Server-Sent Events (SSE) for a specific node.

methods.name: GetMCPMetricsHandler
methods.description: Returns MCP metrics; currently unimplemented, returns empty metrics.
